titleText.simpleText: Mix - Stephan Bodzin live for Cercle at Piz Gloria, Switzerland

comments.text: I wake up, get my phone and put music on. I'm living on the earth for 29 years and listen to techno since i'm 8. Later the years you are understand music more and more. I've played a lot of artist from Classical music to Hip-Hop to Pop to Rock. But no artist can make me cry in seconds, unless Paul Kalkbrenner. Since the day i found Sky and Sand i'm listening to Paul. It started first with the Part Album, i was getting goosebumps all the time and a little bit of lump in my throat. From there Parachute, Graf Zahl and now Invisible i'm getting emotional all the time listening to this masterpiece. I don't know what it is, but to me Paul is a God of music!
